decisions: Minutes of the February 20, 2025 board meeting approved as amended with unanimous consent.
Cost Reduction Task Force approved, co-led by Pierre Dubois and Aiyana Park, with findings due by April 30, 2025.
Escalation of collection procedures approved for two client accounts with overdue balances exceeding 60 days.

Expansion of Polestar Industries engagement to include digital transformation advisory services approved in principle; staffing assessment due March 28, 2025; contract amendment targeting additional $480,000 in scope to be finalized by April 30, 2025; Margaret Holvan to lead renegotiation discussions by April 10, 2025.
Pursuit of a right-of-first-refusal agreement for fourth-floor office space approved; final leasing decision deferred to April 17, 2025 board meeting.

Budget of up to $35,000 approved for external compensation benchmarking study due by May 15, 2025; Career Development Framework for consultant staff to be presented at May board meeting; five open positions authorized for expedited hiring.
Aiyana Park designated as internal coordinator for May 8, 2025 Annual Client Appreciation Event; all vendor agreements to be executed by April 1, 2025.
Next board meeting set for April 17, 2025 at 9:00 AM.
